scope: Saved current Moses South residual, timing and balance-input identifiability diagnostics; no PF, fitted dispatch or default parameter selection.
primary_cohort: Current repaired source/equation/loss/recovery-qualified 2025 hours on the preserved 8760-slot UTC axis.
required_balance_adjustment: Report both observation-minus-primary with the current terminal correction fixed, and observation-minus-midpoint with that correction removed. Both are conditional oracle requirements, never replacement source data.
units: public MW for comparison and component diagnostics; original model/gamma provenance retained
time_axis: Physical UTC hours; America/New_York only for calendar grouping. Both fall DST folds and the spring clock transition remain on the UTC axis.
positive_lag_meaning: Use the component or observation at t+lag when evaluating hour t.
timing_prediction_rule: At hour t, change exactly one signed balance component x(t) to x(t+lag), holding other components and the t terminal correction fixed. For P32, change only observation time. These are accounting sensitivities, not new AC solutions.
timing_cohorts: component-specific intersection across all three lags
common intersection across all components and all three lags
timing_availability: Require the original current-qualified evaluation hour, actual neighboring physical-hour continuity, unchanged topology state across the triplet, and explicit per-source availability when supplied. Otherwise conservatively require all three current-qualified hours and disclose that restriction.
timing_reporting: Report every lag including zero, baseline and changed MAE/RMSE/bias on exactly the same cohort, and calendar-month stability; never choose a production shift by its error.
ramps: One physical-hour backward differences with both adjacent hours eligible and in the same topology state.
conditional_groups: Source-component quartiles and sign regimes fixed without residual values; residual quantiles are described only as outcome summaries, not causal groups.
association_limit: Descriptive and noncausal; serial dependence, common source allocation and shared accounting terms preclude causal attribution or independent-sample significance claims.
bounds: Compare one-at-a-time required StLawrence adjustment with its supplied hourly finite bounds when available; report infeasible signs/magnitudes and monthly-energy implications without applying it. Physical balance/meter equivalence remains an assumption.
prohibited_actions: fit constant or hourly dispatch correction to observations
promote oracle values to model inputs
